children: Progressive posted a drop in profit for the month of August, despite growth in net premiums written and earned.
The insurance company on Friday posted a monthly net income of $951 million, or $1.63 a share, compared with $1.22 billion, or $2.07 a share, in the same period a year earlier.
Net premiums written rose 6%, to $7.61 billion, while net premiums earned rose 5%, to $7.35 billion.
